name: Brown
bio: Several men named only Brown appear in these items. One, a trail hand with a Texas herd, was shot and killed by a fellow herder in 1884; a Brown also shot in the Bad Lands Gun Club matches in 1885; and the firm of Warn & Brown dissolved in June 1885.
